assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The patient has an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
There is concern for potential embolic events or hemodynamic instability
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmic activity
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is coded as Z86.73
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is coded as I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229
The payer denied this service under PR-204
The denial was for lack of medical necessity
The documented clinical scenario directly supports the need for this monitoring
